claim_inventory.evidence: Focused mechanical review of all 18 staged paths. No blocking finding. Approved design JSON matches the saved 45-layer artifact except its catalog source ID. Existing visitor name, role, organization and portrait are retained; only event metadata changes. The gallery adds real front/back renderer captures, and its capture script now reads the same source list. Catalog counts and cold-install checks cover 18 styles. The refined guides match design-text.ts: first/last are word segments, wrap can break long words, and shrink has no minimum readability guarantee. Actual Oríbita 27 exports exposed an awkward hyphenated-name break; a narrower supported typeface fixed the tested examples. Tests and QR checks do not establish universal adaptability. This is single-context review, not independent challenge. Community authentication, media storage and Neon migrations are outside this static slice.
